note: Images named ONLY inside a runtime data file. `ref` is the exact string as it appears in that file — the builder rewrites that string to the local path, and blanks any template prefix, so the code that assembles the URL keeps working.
skippedNote: An image FILENAME carried as metadata beside an asset, not a path. No prefix serves it, so pairing it with one would only be a speculative request at a server belonging to somebody else.
